purpose: Check development-only output interpolation against independent, locally seeded DOP853 solutions at fixed off-grid times near the NQC match.

dense_reference.seed: preceding accepted fine-stage state for each off-grid query
dense_reference.first_step_rule: min(0.015625 M, one quarter of the query displacement)

interpretation: This compares numerical output sampling for the same provisional ODE and accepted states. It is not an independent SEOBNRv4 physics reference, a complete waveform test, or release qualification. Report all sampler errors and dense-reference spread without retuning thresholds.
